<?php

const M = 1000000007;

class Co {
    public int $v;

    public function __construct(int $v) {
        $this->v = (($v % M) + M) % M;
    }

    public static function fromInt(int $v): Co {
        return new Co($v);
    }

    public function add(Co $o): Co {
        return new Co($this->v + $o->v);
    }

    public function sub(Co $o): Co {
        return new Co($this->v - $o->v);
    }

    public function mul(Co $o): Co {
        return new Co(intval(($this->v * 1) * ($o->v * 1) % M));
    }

    public function div(Co $o): Co {
        return $this->mul($o->pow(M - 2));
    }

    public function pow(int $n): Co {
        $a = new Co($this->v);
        $res = new Co(1);
        while ($n > 0) {
            if ($n & 1) {
                $res = $res->mul($a);
            }
            $a = $a->mul($a);
            $n >>= 1;
        }
        return $res;
    }

    public function __toString(): string {
        return strval($this->v);
    }
}

class Env {
    public int $k;
    public int $d;
    /** @var ?Co[][] */
    public array $memo;

    public function __construct(int $k, int $d, array $memo) {
        $this->k = $k;
        $this->d = $d;
        $this->memo = $memo;
    }

    public function need(int $n): Co {
        if ($this->memo[$n][0] !== null) {
            return $this->memo[$n][0];
        }
        $sum = new Co(0);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $this->k; $i++) {
            if ($n >= $i) {
                if ($i >= $this->d) {
                    $sum = $sum->add($this->all($n - $i));
                } else {
                    $sum = $sum->add($this->need($n - $i));
                }
            }
        }
        $this->memo[$n][0] = $sum;
        return $sum;
    }

    public function all(int $n): Co {
        if ($this->memo[$n][1] !== null) {
            return $this->memo[$n][1];
        }
        $sum = new Co(0);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $this->k; $i++) {
            if ($n >= $i) {
                $sum = $sum->add($this->all($n - $i));
            }
        }
        $this->memo[$n][1] = $sum;
        return $sum;
    }
}

class Scanner {
    private array $tokens = [];
    private int $idx = 0;

    public function __construct() {
        $data = trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN));
        if ($data === '') {
            $this->tokens = [];
        } else {
            $this->tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', $data);
        }
        $this->idx = 0;
    }

    public function read(): string {
        return $this->tokens[$this->idx++];
    }

    public function readInt(): int {
        return intval($this->read());
    }

    public function readNInt(int $n): array {
        $res = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $res[] = $this->readInt();
        }
        return $res;
    }

    public function chars(): array {
        return str_split($this->read());
    }
}

function vecs($init, ...$dims) {
    $dims = array_reverse($dims);
    $arr = $init;
    foreach ($dims as $dim) {
        $tmp = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $dim; $i++) {
            $tmp[] = $arr;
        }
        $arr = $tmp;
    }
    return $arr;
}

function main() {
    $scan = new Scanner();
    $n = $scan->readInt();
    $k = $scan->readInt();
    $d = $scan->readInt();
    $memo = vecs(null, $n + 1, 2);
    $memo[0][1] = Co::fromInt(1);
    $env = new Env($k, $d, $memo);
    echo $env->need($n) . PHP_EOL;
}

main();

<?php

const M = 1000000007;

class Co {
    public int $v;

    public function __construct(int $value) {
        $this->v = (($value % M) + M) % M;
    }

    public static function fromInt(int $value): Co {
        return new Co($value);
    }

    public function pow(int $n): Co {
        $a = new Co($this->v);
        $res = new Co(1);
        while ($n > 0) {
            if ($n & 1) {
                $res = $res->mul($a);
            }
            $a = $a->mul($a);
            $n >>= 1;
        }
        return $res;
    }

    public function add(Co $other): Co {
        return new Co($this->v + $other->v);
    }

    public function sub(Co $other): Co {
        return new Co($this->v - $other->v);
    }

    public function mul(Co $other): Co {
        return new Co(intval(($this->v * 1) * ($other->v * 1)));
    }

    public function div(Co $rhs): Co {
        return $this->mul($rhs->pow(M - 2));
    }
}

class Env {
    public int $k;
    public int $d;
    /** @var ?Co[][] */
    public array $memo;

    public function __construct(int $k, int $d, array $memo) {
        $this->k = $k;
        $this->d = $d;
        $this->memo = $memo;
    }

    public function need(int $n): Co {
        if ($this->memo[$n][0] !== null) {
            return $this->memo[$n][0];
        }
        $sum = new Co(0);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $this->k; $i++) {
            if ($n >= $i) {
                if ($i >= $this->d) {
                    $sum = $sum->add($this->all($n - $i));
                } else {
                    $sum = $sum->add($this->need($n - $i));
                }
            }
        }
        $this->memo[$n][0] = $sum;
        return $sum;
    }

    public function all(int $n): Co {
        if ($this->memo[$n][1] !== null) {
            return $this->memo[$n][1];
        }
        $sum = new Co(0);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= $this->k; $i++) {
            if ($n >= $i) {
                $sum = $sum->add($this->all($n - $i));
            }
        }
        $this->memo[$n][1] = $sum;
        return $sum;
    }
}

class Scanner {
    private array $tokens = [];
    private int $idx = 0;

    public function __construct() {
        $data = trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN));
        if ($data === '') {
            $this->tokens = [];
        } else {
            $this->tokens = preg_split('/\s+/', $data);
        }
        $this->idx = 0;
    }

    public function read() {
        return $this->tokens[$this->idx++];
    }

    public function readInt(): int {
        return intval($this->read());
    }

    public function readString(): string {
        return strval($this->read());
    }

    public function readChars(): array {
        return preg_split('//u', $this->readString(), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
    }

    public function readnInt(int $n): array {
        $res = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $res[] = $this->readInt();
        }
        return $res;
    }
}

function vecs($init, ...$dims) {
    $dims = array_reverse($dims);
    $arr = $init;
    foreach ($dims as $dim) {
        $tmp = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $dim; $i++) {
            $tmp[$i] = $arr;
        }
        $arr = $tmp;
    }
    return $arr;
}

$n = $scan->readInt();
$k = $scan->readInt();

$memo = vecs(null, $n + 1, 2);
$env = new Env($k, $d, $memo);

source_data.prob_desc_description: Quite recently a creative student Lesha had a lecture on trees. After the lecture Lesha was inspired and came up with the tree of his own which he called a k-tree.A k-tree is an infinite rooted tree where:  each vertex has exactly k children;  each edge has some weight;  if we look at the edges that goes from some vertex to its children (exactly k edges), then their weights will equal 1, 2, 3, ..., k. The picture below shows a part of a 3-tree.      As soon as Dima, a good friend of Lesha, found out about the tree, he immediately wondered: "How many paths of total weight n (the sum of all weights of the edges in the path) are there, starting from the root of a k-tree and also containing at least one edge of weight at least d?".Help Dima find an answer to his question. As the number of ways can be rather large, print it modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print a single integer — the answer to the problem modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: A single line contains three space-separated integers: n, k and d (1 ≤ n, k ≤ 100; 1 ≤ d ≤ k).
